profiles.name: Admin / Platform Operator
profiles.role: Internal user managing platform configuration, user accounts, and operational concerns.
goals: Provision and de-provision users quickly
Diagnose issues from logs and metrics without engineer support
Enforce policy across tenants without per-tenant manual steps
constraints: Operates from a desktop with multiple monitors
Touches sensitive surfaces — auth, billing, schema
Read-heavy workflow with rare but high-stakes write actions
painPoints: Tools that require multiple clicks to do common operations
Audit trails that don't capture who did what when
Unsafe defaults that turn a misclick into an incident

profiles.name: End User / Customer
profiles.role: External user interacting with the product to accomplish their own goals.
goals: Complete the primary task quickly without learning the product
Recover gracefully from mistakes without losing work
Understand status without reading documentation
constraints: May be on mobile, tablet, or desktop unpredictably
Variable connectivity — must tolerate offline transitions
Limited tolerance for jargon or product-specific terminology
painPoints: Forms that lose state on validation errors
Loading states that don't communicate what's happening
Error messages that say *what* went wrong but not *what to do next*

profiles.name: Power User
profiles.role: Heavy customer who uses the product for hours a day and has memorised its shape.
goals: Skip the hand-holding — execute by keyboard, by URL, by API
Customise defaults to match their established workflow
Bulk-operate where the UI assumes one-at-a-time
constraints: Resistant to UI churn — re-learning costs them productivity
Has built tooling on top of stable surfaces (URLs, API contracts)
Reports bugs the tier 1 audience doesn't notice
painPoints: Modal dialogs that block keyboard navigation
Pagination forced on workflows that need a complete view
Breaking changes shipped without notice

profiles.name: Support / Customer Success
profiles.role: Internal user resolving customer-reported issues, often impersonating or assisting customers.
goals: See what the customer is seeing without leaving their seat
Reproduce issues with the customer's data and configuration
Resolve in one touch where possible
constraints: May not have engineering access — depends on UI affordances
Often working with a customer in real time on a call
Needs auditability — who saw what, when, on whose behalf
painPoints: Impersonation modes that drift from the real customer experience
Logs without correlation IDs
Issues that require an engineer to reproduce

profiles.name: Developer / API Consumer
profiles.role: External or internal developer integrating with the product's API or extending it.
goals: Find the relevant endpoint and example without reading the whole reference
Fail fast and obviously when their request is malformed
Trust that documented behaviour matches actual behaviour
constraints: Uses the API from heterogeneous environments — CLI, web, server, edge
Sensitive to rate limits, latency, and contract churn
Reads error responses programmatically, not just visually
painPoints: Errors returned as 200 with `{success: false}`
Documentation drift — examples that don't run
Versioning schemes that aren't enforced

profiles.name: Finance / Billing
profiles.role: Internal user who needs accurate, auditable, and timely visibility into revenue and spend.
goals: Reconcile reported revenue against ledger systems
Trace any charge or refund back to the originating event
Close the period without engineering escalation
constraints: Works on a strict monthly cadence with hard external deadlines
Cannot tolerate silent data corrections — every change must be auditable
Often handing off to external auditors who don't know the product
painPoints: Reports whose numbers change retroactively without an audit trail
Currency or timezone handling that's silently inconsistent
Ledger-of-record ambiguity (which system tells the truth?)

profiles.name: Auditor / Compliance
profiles.role: Internal or external auditor verifying the system meets policy, regulatory, or contractual requirements.
goals: Sample any record and trace its full lifecycle
Confirm that controls (auth, encryption, retention) are not just configured but observed
Produce evidence packages without product-team involvement
constraints: May be reviewing the system years after the work was done
Cannot accept 'we'll fix it next sprint' as remediation
Reads logs, configs, and admin interfaces — not source code
painPoints: Logs that drop fields or change schema without retention
Configurations that drift from documentation
Audit-only roles that need broader access than they should have

profiles.name: Field Worker / Mobile-first User
profiles.role: External or internal user operating in the field, often on mobile, often with intermittent connectivity.
goals: Capture observations on-site without re-typing back at the desk
Sync when connectivity returns without losing data
Operate single-handed where the workflow demands it
constraints: Variable network — offline transitions are routine, not exceptional
Outdoor lighting, gloves, one-handed use
Limited screen real estate; high-stakes context (often safety-related)
painPoints: Forms that assume always-on connectivity
UIs that fail silently when offline rather than queueing
Image capture that loses metadata or compresses too aggressively
